recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-14334 unless a future Patient Care decision intentionally narrows CareTeam.participant.member reference targets.
issue_request: FHIR-14334 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to add Reference(PractitionerRole) to CareTeam.participant.member so a care team can identify a practitioner acting in a facility-specific role with role-specific contact or availability context.
initial_application: Historical commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92 explicitly mentions GF#14334 and added PractitionerRole to the CareTeam.participant.member reference list in the then-authoritative careteam spreadsheet. The 2021 source rework moved the definition into source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml, where the PractitionerRole targetProfile remains present.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-15129 is a duplicate of FHIR-14334. Later CareTeam issues FHIR-48432 and FHIR-51595 added Group and HealthcareService to participant.member/onBehalfOf, and FHIR-42928 broadened onBehalfOf behavior, but none supersede or remove the PractitionerRole member target. Direct FHIR-14334 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record; Patient Care Confluence minutes list GF#14334 and duplicate GF#15129 in the CareTeam backlog.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml already includes http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/PractitionerRole under CareTeam.participant.member, and the CareTeam participant search parameter still points at CareTeam.participant.member.

related_jiras.note: Duplicate issue asking for CareTeam.participant.member PractitionerRole support.
Later applied issue added Group to CareTeam.participant.member and onBehalfOf without disturbing PractitionerRole.
Later applied issue added HealthcareService to CareTeam.participant.member and onBehalfOf without disturbing PractitionerRole.
Later onBehalfOf issue broadened onBehalfOf targets and removed its Practitioner-only invariant; it does not alter the member PractitionerRole decision.
